description: Source code for handling WiFi associated clients web configuration, including encoding and decoding JSON subdocuments, translation between data representations, and related utility functions.

methods.name: access_check_associated_clients_subdoc
methods.description: Checks access permissions for associated clients subdocument.

methods.name: translate_from_associated_clients_subdoc
methods.description: Translates data from associated clients subdocument to internal representation.

methods.name: translate_to_associated_clients_subdoc
methods.description: Translates data from internal representation to associated clients subdocument.

methods.name: encode_associated_clients_subdoc
methods.description: Encodes associated clients data into JSON subdocument.

methods.name: decode_associated_clients_subdoc
methods.description: Decodes JSON subdocument into internal associated clients data structure.
